name: codex
description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

activitySummary.title: Tasks activity summaries
activitySummary.description: Describe each running thread in the pane footer using Qoder DeepSeek-Flash. Calls run directly, without proxy variables, about once every two minutes when activity changes.

paneBackground.title: Tasks pane background
paneBackground.description: Colour the Codex tasks pane paints behind itself, so it matches your terminal instead of the engine's grey. Something like rgb(42,42,42) or #1e1e1e; empty keeps the engine's own.
